name: 92008 · Carlsbad, CA
findings: ZIP 92008 (Carlsbad) has 192 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92008 (Carlsbad) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 22 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
